title: Meta Ad Library Scraper & Change Tracker
description: Give it what to search, a spend cap, and (for scheduled runs) a monitor id. Everything else has a sane default.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to search the Ad Library for, e.g. "protein powder". One query per term. Use this OR pageIds OR adLibraryUrls — at least one is required.

pageIds.title: Facebook Page IDs
pageIds.description: Numeric Page IDs to pull every ad for — the way to track a specific competitor. Find the ID in the Ad Library URL as view_all_page_id=...

advertiserDomains.title: Advertiser domains (finds the right Page)
advertiserDomains.description: Give a website, e.g. nike.com, and get that brand's ads without the same-name impostors. Searching a brand by name returns every unrelated Page sharing it; this searches the name and then keeps only ads whose destination is that domain. Subdomains included.

adLibraryUrls.title: Ad Library URLs
adLibraryUrls.description: Paste Ad Library URLs straight from the browser. Filters in the URL (country, active status, media type, page) are read and applied.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes (US, DE, IT), or ALL for every country. Note: outside the EU only political and issue ads carry spend and impression figures — see the README FAQ.

activeStatus.title: Active status
activeStatus.description: Only ads currently running, only ones that stopped, or both.

adType.title: Ad type
adType.description: All ads, or only political and issue ads (the ones with spend, impressions and funding data).

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Keep only ads using this media type. Meta applies this server-side, so it also reduces how much is fetched.

maxAds.title: Max ads (spend cap)
maxAds.description: Hard ceiling on billable ads for this run. The run stops cleanly at this number and says so in the status message — it never fails. This is your spend control: at $0.60 per 1,000 ads, 1,000 ads costs $0.60.

maxCostUsd.title: Max cost (USD)
maxCostUsd.description: Optional second ceiling, in dollars. Whichever limit is reached first stops the run. Leave empty to rely on Max ads alone.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Safety valve against a query that paginates forever. 10 ads per page.

monitorMode.title: Monitor mode
monitorMode.description: For scheduled runs. 'Annotate' returns every ad tagged new/changed/unchanged. 'Changes only' returns just what is new or changed — and you are only billed for those. Unchanged and removed ads are always free.

monitorId.title: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Names the memory this schedule diffs against. Use a different ID per schedule so two schedules never diff each other's ads.

emitRemoved.title: Report removed ads
emitRemoved.description: Emit a free record when an ad that was running has stopped. Only queries that actually succeeded can report removals, so a failed run never fakes a wave of removals.

persistMedia.title: Save media to key-value store
persistMedia.description: Meta's CDN links expire within days. Turn this on to download each image and video into this run's key-value store and rewrite the URLs to permanent ones. Costs extra bandwidth; off by default.

includeCards.title: Include carousel cards
includeCards.description: Keep the per-card breakdown of carousel ads. Media from cards is always collected either way.

publisherPlatforms.title: Platforms
publisherPlatforms.description: Keep only ads shown on these platforms: FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, MESSENGER, AUDIENCE_NETWORK, THREADS. Filtered ads are never billed.

minDaysRunning.title: Minimum days running
minDaysRunning.description: Keep only ads live at least this long. Long-running ads are the standard proxy for a winning creative — but see the README: it is a proxy, not a performance metric.

maxDaysRunning.title: Maximum days running
maxDaysRunning.description: Keep only ads live at most this long — useful for spotting fresh creative launches.

startedAfter.title: Started after
startedAfter.description: Keep ads that started on or after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or a relative form like "30 days".

startedBefore.title: Started before
startedBefore.description: Keep ads that started on or before this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD or "6 months".

excludeDisplayFormats.title: Exclude ad formats
excludeDisplayFormats.description: Drop these display formats, e.g. DCO — the format most often returning thin or empty creatives.

requireMedia.title: Only ads with creatives
requireMedia.description: Drop ads with no image and no video. You are not billed for what is dropped.

minVariantCount.title: Minimum variant count
minVariantCount.description: Keep only creatives Meta grouped into at least this many near-identical copies — the closest public signal that a creative is being scaled.

maxAdsPerPage.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerPage.description: Keep at most this many ads per Facebook Page. A keyword search usually returns the same few advertisers hundreds of times; set 1 to see one ad per advertiser. Applied before billing, so it cuts the cost too.

bodyContains.title: Ad copy contains
bodyContains.description: Keep ads whose copy contains any of these words. Searches every body, headline and card, not just the main text.

bodyExcludes.title: Ad copy excludes
bodyExcludes.description: Drop ads whose copy contains any of these words.

linkDomains.title: Destination domains
linkDomains.description: Keep only ads pointing at these domains, e.g. nike.com (subdomains included). Also the reliable way to tell two identically-named Pages apart.

resumeFromCheckpoint.title: Resume an interrupted run
resumeFromCheckpoint.description: If a previous run was cut short — a crash, a proxy failure, or an Apify platform migration — continue from the exact page it reached instead of starting over. Ads already collected are not fetched or billed again. Turn off to force a clean run from the top.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL (push the changes)
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives a POST when the run finishes: the new, changed, scaling and stopped ads, plus a run-status block saying whether the run was complete enough to trust them. A failed webhook never fails the run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Strongly recommended. Meta blocks a single IP after roughly 47 requests (about 470 ads) and in our tests that block lasted hours. Residential proxies with automatic session rotation are what make large runs work.
